definitions.explanation: The table on which table tennis is played, divided by a net across the middle. Built from {卓球|たっきゅう} (table tennis) + {台|だい} (stand; table).

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: We lined up the table tennis tables in the gym.

examples.japanese: {卓球台|たっきゅうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折|お}りたたんで⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: We folded up the ping-pong table and put it away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてあって→置く：01092_oku⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: There was a ping-pong table in the lobby of the hot-spring inn, and our family enjoyed it.

notes:
The playing table for table tennis. A folding {卓球台|たっきゅうだい} is a familiar fixture of school gyms and hot-spring inns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卓球台|たっきゅうだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to set up table tennis tables
- {折|お}りたたみ{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}: a folding ping-pong table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卓球|たっきゅう}→卓球：18289_takkyuu⟧: table tennis; ping-pong — the sport itself
- ⟦ピンポン→ピンポン：27067_pinpon⟧: ping-pong — a casual loanword for the game
